findings.quote: they gave orders to carry off the most valuable furnishings and whatever could be transported
findings.problem: Greek: τῆς μὲν κατασκευῆς τὰ πολυτελέστατα καὶ τὰ δυνατὰ κομίζεσθαι διέλεγον - they picked out/selected (διέλεγον) the most valuable furnishings, and those that could be carried; no order is given.
findings.proposed_fix: they picked out the most valuable furnishings, and whatever could be carried, to take away

units.note: Opening Greek words τοῖς προειρημένοις complete the last sentence of ch. 9 (ἐπὶ τοῖς προειρημένοις); English ch. 10 opening is a seam paraphrase, not a sense error.

findings.quote: they immediately fell upon it from the direction of Thermus and pressed hard on the last men in the column
findings.problem: Greek: ἐπέβαλον εὐθέως εἰς τὸν Θέρμον καὶ προσέκειντο τοῖς ἐσχάτοις - they immediately burst into/occupied Thermus (which Philip's rear had just left) and pressed on the rearmost; not an attack coming from Thermus.
findings.proposed_fix: they immediately burst into Thermus and pressed hard on the last men in the column

units.note: Chapter-end [...] marks a seam into ch. 14 (ἀποπειρώμενος), acceptable.
Greek breaks off mid-word (ἀπαγα-); English ends at a full stop, an acceptable seam.
